title: Verify: Shutdown clears scene and store focus unit tests
summary: Unit tests that shutdown blurs objects and nulls the store id.
description: Add tests/bootSceneShutdownFocus.test.ts using the Phaser/content/buildScene mocks from tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Focused object is blurred and store id null after shutdown.
technical_constraints: All Phaser, content and engine dependencies mocked

steps.action: Copy the vi.mock blocks and makeFakeObject from tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts. Test 'blurs focused object and nulls store id': set fake.isFocused = true, setState focusedObjectId 'bookshelf', boot.create(), find the 'shutdown' call in events.once.mock.calls and invoke it; assert fake.blur called once and useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId === null. Test 'no focus': isFocused false, focusedObjectId null; invoke shutdown; assert blur not called and id null.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneShutdownFocus.test.ts
